title: Sunday at the Pet Market
description: People surround a red hen at the Sunday pet market in Kolkata, India. Kolkata is home to Galiff Street Pet Market, which is considered by some as the oldest and largest pet market in India. People from across the city—and the world—visit the bustling market to observe and purchase exotic birds, fish, cats, dogs, chickens, and ducks. Photographer Julia Coddington specializes in street photography, and notes on her website that what she loves the most about her specialty "is to lose myself in my invisibility and melt into the scene. It’s almost a fugue-like state, like I’m not there, or like a fly on the wall, or wearing an invisibility cloak."
translated_description: 在印度加尔各答的周日宠物市场上，人们围着一只红母鸡。加尔各答是加利夫街宠物市场的所在地，一些人认为这是印度历史最悠久、规模最大的宠物市场。来自全城乃至世界各地的人们都会来到这个熙熙攘攘的市场，观赏和购买珍禽异鸟、鱼类、猫狗、鸡鸭等宠物。摄影师朱莉娅·科丁顿专攻街头摄影，她在个人网站上写道，自己最钟爱这项专长之处在于“能隐没于无形，融入场景之中。那几乎是一种神游般的状态，仿佛我不在场，如同墙上的苍蝇，或是披着隐形斗篷。”
